messages:
Amanda S: Quick sync — Polaris RFI. Need owners for: 1) capability matrix columns & answers, 2) PoC schedule (preferred weekend window?), 3) pricing options for hosted vs reserved, and 4) security questionnaire Q3 (KMS/HSM). Can folks ack and take items?
Vikram R: Ack. I can own the capability matrix. Thoughts on columns?
Amanda S: Thanks. Suggested columns: Feature | Supported (Y/N) | Deployment modes (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) | SLA (p50/p95) | Data residency | KMS/HSM integration | Max concurrent QPS | Typical p95 latency (tokens=512) | Cost per 1M tokens or reserved commit | Known limitations/notes
Vikram R: That looks good. I'll start a CSV. Sample rows to seed: 
```
Text generation, Y, Hosted/Dedicated/Private, 99.95/120ms, multi-region, KMS/HSM via customer keywrap, 300 QPS per 8-GPU pool, 120ms, $0.0009/token (hosted) or $18,000/mo reserved, GPU-quantization lowers cost but may increase latency
Embeddings, Y, Hosted/Dedicated, 99.99/80ms, EU/US, KMS only, 120 QPS, 80ms, $0.0004/embedding unit, no private on-prem option yet
```
Leah M: Quick Q on the security questionnaire — Q3 asks for HSM certificate and network diagrams. Can we attach a redacted HSM attestation and an anonymized VPC peering diagram? Legal will need to sign off on redactions.
Amanda S: Yes, redacted attestation is fine. Leah, can you coordinate with Security to get the attestation and a KMS flow diagram (no IPs)? If Legal needs to redline MSA, loop in @legal.
Raj (salesbot): Attachment uploaded: polaris_rfi_capability_matrix_v1.csv -> https://drive.redwood/polaris_rfi_capability_matrix_v1.csv :page_facing_up:
Vikram R: Nice — I pulled the CSV and added the initial rows. Two ask items: 1) PoC schedule — Polaris prefers a mid-April kickoff and is available weekends for provisioning, 2) Pricing — they want an apples-to-apples cost comparison for 500k queries/day for 3 months.
Amanda S: For PoC I propose: provisioning weekend (Sat AM) to avoid their production traffic, baseline perf tests in week 1, realistic traffic replay week 2, security hardening + pen test week 3, handover week 4. Can we confirm an ops window?
Leah M: Ops can do Sat provisioning. ops-bot: please reserve 2026-04-11 08:00-12:00 UTC for dedicated pool setup (if approved).
ops-bot: Reservation acknowledged — tentative hold created for 2026-04-11 08:00-12:00 UTC. Please confirm once PO is approved.
Vikram R: For pricing, I'll draft two scenarios in the CSV: A) Hosted pay-as-you-go (token+embeddings mix) with cost estimator line items, B) Reserved (monthly commit) with burst capacity. Example numbers (draft): Hosted ~ $0.00095/token equivalent; Reserved 8-GPU pool $18,500/mo + $0.15/extra token after commit. Will refine with finance.
Leah M: Data residency: Polaris requires EU data at rest. We should show deployment modes that meet EU residency (hosted EU region, dedicated in EU, private deployment on-prem). I'll attach a short note.
Amanda S: Two final asks: Vikram — finish the CSV + mark required follow-ups in the spreadsheet (Security Q3, attachments). Leah — upload redacted attestation and KMS flow. Raj — once updated CSV & attachments live, please re-upload and notify Polaris contact.
Raj (salesbot): Uploaded: polaris_rfi_capability_matrix_v2.csv -> https://drive.redwood/polaris_rfi_capability_matrix_v2.csv. Notifying contact: polaris-rfp@customer.com.
Vikram R: Done a first pass on the security answers column; left comments on Q3 requiring exact attestation ID. Amanda — can you confirm whether we can share the attestation ID or must keep it off the doc?
Amanda S: Keep attestation ID off public doc. Share via encrypted email to their security contact after NDA. Mark as "attestation available on request (encrypted)" in the spreadsheet.
Leah M: Uploaded redacted_kms_flow_v1.pdf -> https://drive.redwood/redacted_kms_flow_v1.pdf. Legal is looped in for MSA redlines.
Amanda S: Great. We'll close the loop after finance provides final pricing numbers. Target: send final RFI package by 2026-04-05 COB. Thanks everyone :rocket:
